theme_score_proposals.reason: The reconciliation of good and painful memories drives the climax.
Olga's caregiving is a significant thread alongside the alien adventure.
Celine's instruction to conceal the markings shapes Rumi's choices and is later challenged.
The spell launches and sustains the quest. Score measures its narrative prominence.

spiritual_source_checks.reference: St. Basil the Great, Address to Young Men on the Right Use of Greek Literature, sections IV–V
spiritual_source_checks.finding: Retain as a paraphrase. Basil advises selecting material that cultivates virtue and avoiding what harms the soul. Applying this advice to film is the site's interpretation.
Use as a discussion connection to looking after others, illustrated by the brothers' care. Keep the Bible reference separate from the film's fantasy premise.
